auto_rotation_note: Any automatic rotation is explicitly identified, pauseable, and subordinate to manual inspection of the current official item.
compact_mobile_discoverability_note: Compact/mobile layouts still reveal lateral continuation rather than hiding later official items behind silent clipping.
continuation_visibility_note: The route makes it obvious that more official items exist beyond the first visible slice rather than presenting the first card as if it were the whole set.
current_item_cue_note: Where only one item or partial slice is visible at a time, the current item and its position in the set are exposed in bounded, reviewable form.
delivery_role_note: Bounded discoverability surface for official voter-information routes that present answer-bearing items in a horizontal rail, snap lane, or carousel.

horizontal_answer_routes.auto_rotation_note: No automatic rotation is used for this answer-bearing lane.
horizontal_answer_routes.compact_mobile_note: On small screens the lane still exposes a visible continuation cue and preserves the same full-list escape.
horizontal_answer_routes.continuation_mode: manual horizontal rail with next/previous controls and swipe support
horizontal_answer_routes.current_item_cue: A visible '2 of 6' label accompanies the current card and updates politely when the visible card changes.
horizontal_answer_routes.escape_note: A stable 'View all locations' link opens the full alphabetical directory outside the rail treatment.

horizontal_rail_surface_label: Example horizontal-rail posture for official voter-information routes
keyboard_and_focus_note: The lane, its controls, and any focusable scroll region remain reachable and understandable by keyboard with a labeled boundary and logical focus behavior.
manual_navigation_controls_note: Next/previous or equivalent controls are labeled clearly and do not depend on hover-only or swipe-only discovery.
pause_and_resume_note: If rotation exists, the voter can stop it and it does not silently resume while the voter is actively inspecting the lane.
refindability_note: A voter can re-find a later item after moving through the lane without waiting for a motion cycle or guessing where the item went.
view_all_or_overview_escape_note: The route preserves a stable full-list or overview path when the rail treatment is not convenient for comparison or re-finding.
